stories.name: Default
stories.reason: The portal has no visible host content until a caller supplies hydrated children and a layer container.

stories.name: Empty portal
stories.reason: The portal deliberately emits no visible content when its host receives no children.

stories.name: Long portal content

args.children: A deliberately long portal message demonstrates that the host owns wrapping when content is supplied.

stories.reason: The contract documents the portal host boundary; visible content is supplied by the caller rather than this primitive.
